title: Persistent Issues and Lack of Solutions in Google Keep Notes
body:
Hello,

I’ve been using Google Keep Notes for a long time, and I’m extremely disappointed with how the app functions. It keeps users locked into its ecosystem with no proper way to export content or integrate with essential productivity tools like Notion or Apple Notes, which makes it unusable in a modern workflow.

Despite submitting multiple feedback reports, I’ve seen no real improvements or responses from the development team. It’s unacceptable that such basic functionality is missing, and that user concerns are consistently ignored.

I strongly urge you to address these issues as soon as possible. If nothing changes, I’ll be forced to move to more reliable and flexible alternatives.

Looking forward to a clear and timely response.

Sincerely,

title: Love it!
body:
I love it. It's so damn intuitive. And I love the fact that a checked item, when it is unchecked again, it goes back at it's place. That's a good thing keeping in mind that when you go to the same grocery store and have your products in an organized order, it's so simple to uncheck old items and go straight through the super market.

One thing I don't like though: my shared grocery list (which is 80 items long) is "moving slow". It's like the app is buffering or something. I hate that when I'm in a rush.
